text.description_html:
AHI SIG722-630 Contemporary Stainless Flush Ring Pull

This is a heavy duty contemporary design flush mount ring pull. The 3-7/16 inch square stainless steel flush ring pulls is resistant to corrosion, nicks, scratches, and abrasion making it an ideal material for door hardware. The Satin Stainless Steel Contemporary Flush Mount Door Pull is for use on swinging doors, sliding doors, trap doors, cabinet doors. Any door where a flush with the door face pull is desired.

Specifications for the AHI SIG722-630 Stainless Flush Ring Pull:

  • Total Height: 3-7/16" square
  • Total Depth: 7/16"
  • Door Cutout Depth: 5/16"
  • Projection: 1/8" (If square face is not mortised)
  • Door Cutout Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • 1/8" Thick Solid Stainless Steel
  • Packaged with matching satin stainless mounting screws
  • AHI SIG722 Dimensions (PDF)

**Note: If the square flush pull face is NOT mortised into the door, it will have a 1/8" projection off the doors face. Available in Satin Stainless Steel finish only.
